summary: The root Q-S-F describes something weak, fragile, or easily broken. It can refer to a plant that is sappy but delicate, suggesting a lack of strength despite its moisture.
lane: نَبَاتٌ قَصِيفٌ رَيّانُ ذ [ A weak, or fragile, sappy plant ]. (TA, in art. خرع .)
